integrity: The graph, every independent face, every matching pair, every Hasse cover, and the acyclicity of the complete Morse orientation are reconstructed by the bundled verifier. No numerical approximation is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact computation for the single canonical Tutte–Coxeter graph and does not assert a family theorem; literature novelty remains bounded by the aliases and sources inspected.
title: The Tutte–Coxeter independence complex is a wedge of nine eight-spheres
